title: Design Engineering Analytics with Power BI: free learner pack (Course 2, Engxtech, synthetic data)
description:
Practice files for a free 20-video Power BI course for design and product engineers. One running example, a valve seat ring through revisions A, B and C, is used to teach BOM and revisions, NPD stage-gates, drawings and review findings, mass and cost vs target, tolerance stacks (worst case vs RSS), FEA safety factor and Cpk, combining messy CSV exports in Power Query, engineering-change cycle time and cost, validation pass rate and field ppm with a confidence interval, DFMEA, and dashboards.

Contents: an 18-sheet synthetic workbook and 21 monthly change-log CSV exports for the fictional company Engxtech; the finished and start Power BI (.pbix) files for each video (saved with Power BI Desktop 2026.10); per-section exercises with worked solutions; a formula cheat sheet; a capstone brief; and the seeded Python scripts that generated the data.

Engxtech is fictional and all data are synthetic. Content is licensed CC BY 4.0; the scripts in scripts/ are MIT-licensed (see LICENSE-MIT).

Video playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMfVqRIsDgHc
